original_ai_output.title_zh: 三角洲州APC谴责政治暴力，强调良性政治竞争
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚三角洲州全体进步大会党（APC）竞选委员会官员Tonye Timi谴责周六在阿萨巴Nnebisi路发生的政治游行暴力事件。据尼日利亚通讯社报道，警方已确认冲突造成1人死亡、5人受伤。Timi呼吁各方保持克制，并让警方展开彻底调查。

key_facts.fact: 三角洲州APC官员谴责周六政治游行引发的暴力事件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Dr Tonye Timi, an official of the Delta All Progressives Congress (APC) Campaign Council, has condemned the violence that trailed Saturday's road procession

key_facts.fact: 暴力事件发生在阿萨巴Nnebisi路，由支持NDC的Obi/Kwankwaso运动组织的游行期间
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the violence occurred around 12:15 p.m. during a road procession organised by the Obi/Kwankwaso(OK) Movement in support of the NDC

key_facts.fact: 三角洲州警方确认冲突造成1人死亡、5人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Police Command in Delta has confirmed the death of one person during the clash. It also confirmed that five others were injured during the fracas

key_facts.fact: APC官员呼吁允许警方展开彻底、透明和公正的调查并追究责任
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The police should be allowed to conduct a thorough, transparent and impartial investigation into the incident

uncertainties: 暴力事件的具体起因与责任方尚未确认，警方调查仍在进行
伤亡数字来自警方单一来源，尚缺乏交叉验证
